t2i_prompt: A 1440 px wide desktop website section as a flat straight-on UI mockup on a warm limestone page. A very large light-weight sans headline across the top, then a small tab label on a full-width hairline rule. Left 60%: a square-cornered duotone navy and limestone macro photograph of a polypropylene pipe butt-fusion weld bead, shallow depth of field, with fine hairline annotation lines drawn over it. Right: a numbered list with mono slash numerals, each item a short step name and one line of description for <CONTENT>. Calm, tactile.
signature_idea: A duotone macro of a fusion bead stands as the picture of how the train is built, beside a seven-step slash-numbered list.
strengths: duotone navy and limestone photo is calm and on-palette
the weld bead looks like a real PP butt-fusion bead
